description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeManager's command extraction functionality within an iOS app. It tests various scenarios such as the presence or absence of trigger words, timing gaps, and trimming of tokens in voice command transcripts.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManagerExtractCommandTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test cases for extracting commands based on wake words in voice transcripts.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNoTriggerFound
methods.description: Tests that the command extraction function returns nil when no trigger words are present in the transcript.

methods.name: extractCommandTrimsTokensAndResult
methods.description: Tests that the extraction function correctly trims tokens and returns the expected command string after the trigger.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenGapTooShort
methods.description: Tests that the function returns nil if the time gap after the trigger is shorter than the minimum required.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNothingAfterTrigger
methods.description: Tests that nil is returned when there are no tokens following the trigger word.

methods.name: extractCommandIgnoresEmptyTriggers
methods.description: Ensures empty or whitespace-only triggers are ignored, and the command is extracted based on valid triggers.
